summary: Defines Multipath TCP, an experimental extension that lets one TCP connection use several network paths and addresses at the same time. This can improve throughput and resilience, while still looking like ordinary TCP to applications. It was replaced by RFC 8684.

eli5.summary: Instead of sending a long line of friends down one hallway, you split them across several hallways. If one hallway is blocked, the rest still get through.

questions: how can tcp use wifi and cellular at once
